what: Generalized Binomial Moment Transformations Across Arbitrary Origins
title: Generalized Binomial Moment Transformations Across Arbitrary Origins
text: convmoment implements generalized binomial framework transforming statistical moments order across arbitrary origins. One unified rule replaces separate formulas raw--raw, raw--central, central--raw conversions. method uses symbolic binomial operator: makes transformations exact (machine precision), extensible order, data-free — convert pre-computed moments O(r²) instead O(n·r).

what: convmoment: Generalized Binomial Moment Transformations Across Arbitrary Origins — convmoment-package
title: convmoment: Generalized Binomial Moment Transformations Across Arbitrary Origins — convmoment-package
text: Implements generalized binomial framework transforming statistical moments order across arbitrary origins. Provides unified method raw--raw, raw--central, central--raw moment conversions using single origin-shift parameter b = - k symbolic binomial operator (+ b)^r ^j -> mu'_j(). Includes functions moment transformation, direct moment computation data, validation theoretical distributions (Binomial, Normal).
